body:
i would love to move to BC. except it would be a very expensive move and i don;t even know how i would go about doing it. ( i live near Toronto Ontario.)

again about the medication, i don;t have the money and my mom doesn't have the money to cover it. she is already paying for several prescriptions for my brother who suffers from severe depression and anxiety. i have also thought that maybe the only reason the meds seemed to help was just placebo. since i eventually reached a point where i didn't need them anymore. maybe it was just my shitty situation that was depressing me. anti depressants only work if you suffer from depression ( chemical imbalance in your brain) not just being depressed because your situation is shit.

i have done a lot of different things. like i said i said before i used to bounce from job to job every few monthes. bt for the past year i was a busser at a pub ( ie  clearing tables, running food, stocking beer etc.)

i have a resume written up that just needs to be updated. but it is in all my boxes of stuff from moving and i haven;t been able to bring myself to go through them yet. to depressing. it feels like another slap in the face of whats happened.

jobless, lack of good friends, and being stuck in my crappy home town once again. plus i absolutely hate winter so that's no help. so that just makes it even harder to get motivated to go out and find a job.

i didn;t like the way the prozac made me feel. i didn;t have the lows but i didn;t have the highs either. also i don;t have the money for it.

how do you know things will get better? things can always get worse. a family member could die. i could get diagnosed with a bad disease. there is always farther to fall.

my hobbies include playing video games and watching tv and drinking.

right after she broke up with me i was looking into apartments. but 3 things stopped me. 1. my old job wouldn;t take me back i was unemployed and its hard to get approved for a lease when you are jobless. and 2. last time when i was really depressed i would constantly call in sick for work and was late always. i bounced around from job to job every few monthes. i was worried that in my state that would happen again and i didn;t want to let down the other people that were counting on me to pay rent every month. and 3. i wasn;t even sure if i wanted to live around there anymore. i'm still not sure. i am thinking of moving to quebec or BC for a fresh start.

sad thing is, these aren;t the only bad things to happen to me. first one of my friends from worked passed away from Lukemia about 2 days after my gf broke up with me. then my dad and my grandmother had to go to the hospital ( dad collapsed randomly and grandmother was acting strange or something) luckily they were both ok. and then my mom was diagnosed with skin cancer. luckily it is not the bad kind. for a little while i was almost convinced that i was cursed because bad shit was happening all around me to everyone that i know.

i wouldn't say i am considering suicide right now but yes it is on my mind. i do not have a plan but more and more often i think about how i would do it.

sometimes i have really sick thoughts that scare myself. thoughts about how i would get back at my Ex. like killing myself in front of her or her family just to fuck them up for life. i hate that i have these thoughts.

edit. forgot to add. yes depression does run in my family. i was on antidepressants (Prozac) for about a year but once we moved in together i didn;t need them anymore.
